data.name: San Diego Bay - Sunset Cruise
data.headline: Intimate 60–90 minute public sunset cruise aboard an all‑electric Duffy boat through San Diego Bay.
data.description: Experience San Diego’s golden hour aboard a cozy, all‑electric Duffy boat on this intimate shared sunset cruise. With room for up to six guests (10 on Private Cruises), the quiet electric motor offers a smooth ride and panoramic views of Mission Bay, waterfront homes, and local wildlife. Settle into plush seating, stream your favorite music through the Bluetooth speaker, and enjoy photo opportunities as the sky turns pink and gold. The relaxed atmosphere suits couples, friends, solo travelers, and anyone after a peaceful evening on the water.
data.highlights:
* Intimate six‑passenger shared cruise for a personalized experience
* Smooth, quiet, eco‑friendly electric Duffy boat
* Stunning sunset views across San Diego Bay
* Cozy blankets available on cooler evenings
data.duration: 60–90 minutes (2 Hour Option Available for a Private Cruise Upon Request)

meeting_point.address: 1551 Shelter Island Drive San Diego, CA US 92106
meeting_point.instructions:
##WHERE TO MEET FOR YOUR ACTIVITY##
Please meet your captain before the activity at La Playa Marketplace. This is located near the adult-only pool on the property and is also the watersport rentals office. Your captain will meet you there and walk down to the vessel with you and your party.

*We highly recommend using the restrooms before the excursion, as there are no public restrooms on the bay.*

##PARKING FOR THE ACTIVITY##
Please note that we do not validate parking. Unless you are staying at Kona Kai, San Diego parking is provided on the street and at the park across from the hotel. That being said, remember to arrive early, as parking can be difficult on weekends, holidays, and during the summer.

data.booking_notes:
We look forward to you joining us!
---
We know you are excited to go on your adventure, but before you do, we want to ensure we go over a few essential things that will help make your adventure so much more fun.

##Things to know before arrival

1) Please ensure a Waiver has been filled out for everyone attending the activity.
2) Please make sure you show up 15 minutes before departure.

*If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us via email at ahoy@keeneradventures.com or by text/call/Whatsapp at +1(619)350-3258.

---

##Included with your charter

•	Safety Equipment
•	USCG Licensed Captain
•	a fantastic view of the Sunset
•	Photos and Videos of your time on the water

---

##Gratuity

Our Captains and/or Crew work hard to ensure you and your party have an outstanding time on the water. If you would like to thank them with a little extra, we highly encourage it. The typical gratuity is 20% of the total cost of the ticket, but you can tip however much or little you feel is appropriate. This is, of course, optional and is never required.

---

data.disclaimers:
Cruises last 60–90 minutes, depending on schedule and sunset timing. Operations may run in light wind and light rain; if conditions are unsafe, the operator will reschedule or refund. Private charters are available for up to six guests. Dynamic pricing may apply.

**⚠️ Minimum Guest Requirement Notice**
To operate this activity, we require a minimum of 3 total guests booked. These guests do not need to be part of the same group — all bookings for the date and time count toward the minimum.
If the activity does not reach at least 3 paid tickets, Keener Adventures will offer one of the following options:
- Reschedule to another available date or time
- Upgrade to a Private Cruise for that day at the private‑rate price
- Receive a credit that can be used toward any future Keener Adventures activity

We will notify all booked guests in advance if the minimum is not met.
data.faqs:
How long is the cruise?
Most sunset cruises run 60–90 minutes, depending on the time of year and sunset timing.
Can I bring my own drinks or snacks?
Only on Private Cruises—BYO beverages and light snacks are welcome; mocktail packages are available for purchase.

For ticketed cruises (Public Cruises), we ask that all items be purchased onboard.
Is this cruise kid‑friendly?
Yes—children are welcome, but every passenger counts toward the six‑person capacity.
Is the boat covered?
Yes—the Duffy has a full canopy and clear side panels that can be opened or closed depending on weather.
What should I wear?
Evenings on the water can be cooler than on land; layers or a light jacket are recommended.
Where do we meet?
Your confirmation email includes exact marina directions, parking information, and check‑in instructions.
What if the weather is bad?
The operator runs in light wind and light rain; if conditions are unsafe they will reschedule or refund.
Can I book the whole boat privately?
Yes—private charters are available for groups up to ten guests.
